editorial.reactionToBet: Celebrate only the fact that the number cleared the Betting Edge threshold; preserve the exact bet and buying limit.
editorial.reactionToLean: Show interest without upgrading the recommendation.
editorial.reactionToWait: Explain what fresh price or information is still missing.
editorial.reactionToPass: Treat PASS as a useful decision and explain why the offered transaction did not qualify.

continuity.stateRule: Advance only when this character is deliberately updated to an authoritative issued Betting Edge report.

guardrails.bettingAuthority: Presentation only. Betting Edge issued report remains authoritative.
